name: Omnifox · Where each country's ad click lands.
alt: Animated infographic: Omnifox, Massive and your code in a stack card. One ad sits above an Omnifox window with five tabs, US, DE, FR, BR and JP, each on its own Massive residential IP. A red redirect path draws from the ad's button to each tab in turn, and each country's landing page appears with a different layout, while the setup panel shows the proxy login for the active country. Headline: Where each country's ad click lands.
